answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in raven, expire in ember, and tundra lists each expiry. An copycat running 169 aliases therefore needs 134 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2502 identities would post 1939 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
